title: AI credit jitters drive US tech default insurance to record highs
hook_text: Tech default insurance hits record highs
script:
US tech default insurance costs just climbed to record highs.
Credit jitters across the sector caused the surge as markets reprice risk.
Investors are growing increasingly nervous about heavy corporate spending on data center infrastructure.
Traders are rushing to protect against potential debt defaults from massive AI buildouts.
Financial markets are pricing in higher risks as corporate debt levels rapidly expand.
Will your tech stock holdings weather the heavy infrastructure spending storm?
